status: Status: W1 registry (ADR-0128). Capability ids are permanent once assigned: never renamed, reused or removed. New ids may be added; a retired id is marked in 'status'.
rules: A capability id names one authority. Grants, RoleDefinitions, SpaceAuthorityBindings, the kind-to-capability map and every doc use these ids and no other spelling.

Every capability is critical: a receiver that does not know a required capability refuses the operation and never approximates it (SCOPED_PERMISSIONS_AND_CONVERSATION_ORGANIZATION.md; ADR-0121 rule 7).

'protected': true marks a governance-root or high-risk capability. It is never minted by room.manage_roles or space.manage_roles alone, is not included in a SpaceAuthorityBinding unless the Room grants it under its own governance, and may require quorum (ADR-0122, ADR-0128 rule 8).
'reducing': true marks actions that are authority reductions under ADR-0122 rule 1 and ADR-0128 rule 1 (live after sequencing_timeout, never forks).
Authorization is evaluated at the sending epoch of the event or intent (ADR-0121 rule 1), after the grant cascade (ADR-0122 rule 2) and after active restrictions.
'basis: authorship' means the author of the target may act without a capability; 'basis: membership' means any current member may act.

capabilities.description: send a top-level message or create a poll
send a message with reply_to or thread_root_event_id
set reactions and vote in polls
attach blobs to a message (needed in addition to room.post or room.reply)
set or clear shared room pins
reserved; W1 thread replies need only room.reply (ADR-0121 rule 7)
create a Topic
update, change status of, or move messages between any Topics
invite a person over a 1:1 relationship or issue an invite link (ADR-0128 rules 5-6)
approve join requests and set the join policy, including open links
remove a member (all its endpoints)
set a Room ban; lifting is a committed unban transition under the same capability
set a timeout; ends only through a committed untimeout (ADR-0122 rule 10)
set or lift a posting, media or similar restriction; lifting is committed
set the Room slow-mode interval
moderation.redact another principal's content; close another member's poll
change Room name, avatar and description
change GroupControlState policy.disappearing_timer (ADR-0128 rule 16)
create, edit and assign RoleDefinitions within the actor's ceiling (ADR-0128 rule 10)
start a group call that rings the Room; joining an ongoing call needs membership only
install a ServicePrincipal; a full-room (plaintext) service is a high-risk transition
add a BridgePrincipal that receives plaintext
change non-cryptographic Room security policy (privacy SecurityProfile, new_device_policy, history_policy); never a CryptoProfile and never below an established floor (ADR-0128 rule 8)
change governance principals and thresholds, the coordinator succession order, and SpaceAuthorityBindings
see a private Space's catalog and control state
invite to the Space
admit and remove Space members
change Space name, avatar, description and style
propose and revoke child links
create, edit and assign Space roles within the ceiling
issue Space ModerationDecisions; effect in a Room only via a SpaceDelegatedIntent the Room's binding accepts
change Space governance principals and thresholds
grant or withdraw the Room policy plaintext_egress that lets tainted service/plugin invocations egress (ADR-0124 rule 2, ADR-0129 rule 2)

operations.note: room.reply instead when reply_to or thread_root_event_id is set; plus room.upload when attachments are present
and the capability the original post needed, held at the edit's sending epoch (ADR-0121 rule 7)
the message author (still holding room.post) or room.manage_topics
not needed when the join policy is open and the invite is valid (ADR-0128 rule 6)
an account's own authorized device; admin approval when new_device_policy says so
any member, for a device revoked or quarantined at a validated ACS head (ADR-0128 rules 1-2)
only to the next live device in the recorded succession order, after sequencing_timeout (ADR-0128 rule 1)
